title: Moonwell Editor theme
description: The colours of an interface theme. Hex colours only: #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa; a see-through colour is laid over the panel. A colour left out is worked out from the four required ones.

$schema.description: Where this schema is, for suggestions in the editor you write the file in.

type.description: Sets the header's shading, the scroll bars and number boxes, the defaults for colours left out, and the code theme used when none is chosen.

colors.description: The colours. Four are required; every other one is worked out when left out.

background.base.description: Required. The theme's deepest background: the trigger cards' bodies, and text on the accent colour. The gaps and fields are worked out from it.

background.panel.description: Required. The panels, and the window's frame.

background.gutter.description: The gaps between panels, the title bar and the status bar. Left out: background.base, 22% toward black (light: 7%).

background.raised.description: Rows, headers, cards and buttons inside a panel, and the trigger canvas. Left out: background.panel, 9% toward text.normal.

background.hover.description: Under the pointer. Left out: background.raised.

background.field.description: Text boxes, dropdowns and checkboxes. Left out: background.base, 30% toward black (light: 3%).

background.selection.description: The selected row or item. Left out: accent.normal 32% into background.panel, lightness at most 0.44 (light: 28%, at least 0.84).

background.button.description: A dialog's main button. Left out: accent.normal 40% into background.raised, lightness at most 0.44 (light: 34%, at least 0.8).

border.normal.description: Edges of panels, boxes and menus, and the window's frame. Left out: background.panel, 18% toward text.normal.

border.faint.description: Thin lines between rows in grids. Left out: border.normal at 70%.

text.normal.description: Required. Names, values and most text; text under the pointer.

text.soft.description: The page's default: labels, descriptions and running text. Left out: text.normal, 10% toward background.panel, moved toward text.normal until it reads 4.5 on the panel.

text.muted.description: Secondary text; the edge of a box under the pointer. Left out: text.normal, 18% toward background.panel, moved until it reads 3.

text.faint.description: Hints, placeholders and what is turned off. Left out: text.normal, 55% toward background.panel, moved until it reads 2.

accent.normal.description: Required. Focus rings, and the edge of the focused or hovered box.

accent.text.description: Accent text: the selected label, links and notices. Left out: accent.normal, moved toward text.normal until it reads 3 on the panel.

accent.background.description: The tint behind active chips and picked items. Left out: background.panel, 18% toward accent.normal.

state.changed.description: Values changed from the game's. Left out: VS Code's warning yellow (#cca700, light #bf8803).

state.warning.description: Errors, warnings and the delete buttons. Left out: VS Code's error red (#f14c4c, light #e51400).

state.warningBackground.description: Rows and buttons in a warning state. Left out: background.panel, 18% toward state.warning.

kind.unit.description: The icon and name of units. Left out: VS Code's default terminal blue.

kind.item.description: The icon and name of items. Left out: halfway between kind.upgrade and kind.doodad, the orange between red and yellow.

kind.destructable.description: The icon and name of destructables. Left out: VS Code's default terminal green.

kind.doodad.description: The icon and name of doodads. Left out: VS Code's default terminal yellow.

kind.ability.description: The icon and name of abilities. Left out: VS Code's default terminal cyan.

kind.buff.description: The icon and name of buffs. Left out: VS Code's default terminal magenta.

kind.upgrade.description: The icon and name of upgrades. Left out: VS Code's default terminal red.

terminal.background.description: The terminal's background. Left out: background.panel.

terminal.foreground.description: The terminal's text. Left out: text.normal.

terminal.cursor.description: The terminal's cursor. Left out: text.normal.

terminal.selection.description: The terminal's selected text. Left out: background.selection.
